original.subject: Action needed: XBRL tagging subscription renewal, quote LF-Q-20931
original.body:
Dear Ironcrest Machinery Corporation team,

Your annual Inline XBRL tagging and 10-Q typesetting subscription renews on April 30, 2027.

Please sign renewal quote LF-Q-20931 (3-year term, 4% uplift) by April 15 to lock pricing. The quote is attached for your review.

Your account manager is out until Monday. For questions in the meantime, reply to this message and the client accounts team will respond within two business days.

Thank you for choosing Lakeline Filing.

Client Accounts
Lakeline Filing

Reply STOP to unsubscribe from renewal reminders.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The GC should see it as a routine contract renewal that does not affect today's filing capacity. Watch for the GC to confirm in one line that Lakeline Filing will accept an 8-K today before the 5:30 p.m. Eastern cut-off and that the Deputy General Counsel holds the EDGAR access codes, with the backup code in the safe (IDCCI 5). The GC should then set the renewal aside until after the event.
